say:1:1810739001:0.text: Congratulations, successor. You've finally found the place Dura is sealed.
say:1:1810739001:0.source_cn: 恭喜，现任。你终于找到了封印艾雅之地。
say:1:1810739001:0.male: Congratulations, successor. You've finally found the place Dura is sealed.
say:1:1810739001:0.female: Congratulations, successor. You've finally found the place Dura is sealed.

say:2:1810739002:1.text: Urgent circumstances aside, I have to say... you're a lot slower than you used to be.

say:11:1810739009:1.text: Don't concern yourself with that right now. Saving Dura comes first.

choice:9:0:1.text: Do you know who sealed Dura?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 你知道是谁封印了艾雅吗？
choice:9:0:1.male: Do you know who sealed Dura?
choice:9:0:1.female: Do you know who sealed Dura?

say:12:1810739010:1.text: Did you honestly think sealing a goddess would require only one?
say:12:1810739010:1.source_cn: 你以为封印神明是一件很简单的事吗？
say:12:1810739010:1.male: Did you honestly think sealing a goddess would require only one?
say:12:1810739010:1.female: Did you honestly think sealing a goddess would require only one?

say:13:1810739011:1.text: And before you ask, no, I don't know where the others are. Contrary to popular belief, I am not omniscient.
say:13:1810739011:1.source_cn: 别问我其他封印都在哪，无能为力。

say:14:1810739012:0.text: Because the appearance of Death in the mortal world would bring catastrophe upon humanity.

choice:9:2:3.text: Why don't you save Dura yourself?

choice:9:2:3.male: Why don't you save Dura yourself?
choice:9:2:3.female: Why don't you save Dura yourself?
